_comment: Banking Circle notification delivery. Retry schedule and step count are
the documented ones; time_scale is what makes them watchable.
time_scale divides every delay below. At 3600 an hour becomes a second,
so the full eleven-retry schedule -- which really ends 48 hours after
the first failure -- plays out in about 90 seconds, with the shape and
step count intact. Set it to 1 for real timing.
deactivate_after_retries: the retry guide documents 11 while the OpenAPI
statusMessage text says 10. 11 is the schedule of record here.
batch_flush_interval: how long a partly-filled batch waits before going
out anyway. Without it a subscription with maxNotificationsPerMessage
of 1000 would never deliver until a thousand payments happened.
Per-subscription batch size is set by the client on the subscription
applies when a subscription does not choose one.
